datasets_evaluated.evidence: We curated a new dataset consisting of encrypted traffic from 6 different public datasets: CTU-Malware-Capture; Benign-Capture and Mixture Capture are three datasets produced from Malware Capture Facility Project published by Stratosphere Lab [19].

features_used.evidence: Such features include time-related features (i.e., flow duration of forward traffic and Interval of the arrival time of backward traffic), payload side-channel features (i.e, Payload ratio, length of TCP payload, and total payload per session), our proposed enc features

feature_groups.evidence: The function can extract both session-based and packet-based traffic features with high efficiency. Such features include time-related features (i.e., flow duration of forward traffic and Interval of the arrival time of backward traffic), payload side-channel features

model_family.evidence: The framework is a two-layer detection framework which consists of both deep learning and traditional machine learning algorithms.

metrics.evidence: When evaluating the performance of detection models, accuracy, F1, precision, recall, AUC-ROC, False Positive Rate (FPR), and True Positive Rate (TPR) are selected to provide a more comprehensive analysis of performance results.
